description: This Java class 'V2ExpressionSQLBuilder' generates SQL strings from Spark SQL V2 expressions, supporting various expression types, functions, and aggregate operations.

classes.name: V2ExpressionSQLBuilder
classes.description: A builder class that converts Spark SQL V2 expressions into SQL query strings, supporting various expression types and functions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Main method to convert an Expression object into its SQL string representation.

methods.name: escapeSpecialCharsForLikePattern
methods.description: Escapes special characters ('_' and '%') in strings for LIKE pattern matching.

methods.name: visitLiteral
methods.description: Converts a Literal expression to its SQL string form.

methods.name: visitNamedReference
methods.description: Converts a NamedReference expression to its SQL string form.

methods.name: visitIn
methods.description: Generates SQL for IN clause with a list of values.

methods.name: visitIsNull
methods.description: Generates SQL for IS NULL check.

methods.name: visitIsNotNull
methods.description: Generates SQL for IS NOT NULL check.

methods.name: visitStartsWith
methods.description: Generates SQL for string starts with pattern using LIKE.

methods.name: visitEndsWith
methods.description: Generates SQL for string ends with pattern using LIKE.

methods.name: visitContains
methods.description: Generates SQL for string contains pattern using LIKE.

methods.name: inputToSQL
methods.description: Converts an Expression input to its SQL string, adding parentheses if necessary.

methods.name: visitBinaryComparison
methods.description: Generates SQL for binary comparison operators.

methods.name: visitBinaryComparison
methods.description: Overloaded method to generate SQL for binary comparison with string operator.

methods.name: visitBinaryArithmetic
methods.description: Generates SQL for binary arithmetic operations.

methods.name: visitCast
methods.description: Generates SQL for CAST expressions.

methods.name: visitAnd
methods.description: Generates SQL for AND logical operation.

methods.name: visitOr
methods.description: Generates SQL for OR logical operation.

methods.name: visitNot
methods.description: Generates SQL for NOT operation.

methods.name: visitUnaryArithmetic
methods.description: Generates SQL for unary arithmetic expressions.

methods.name: visitCaseWhen
methods.description: Generates SQL for CASE WHEN expressions.

methods.name: visitSQLFunction
methods.description: Generates SQL for standard SQL functions with Expression array inputs.

methods.name: visitSQLFunction
methods.description: Generates SQL for standard SQL functions with string array inputs.

methods.name: visitAggregateFunction
methods.description: Generates SQL for aggregate functions, handling DISTINCT and special COUNT case.

methods.name: visitAggregateFunction
methods.description: Overloaded method to generate SQL for aggregate functions with string array inputs.

methods.name: visitInverseDistributionFunction
methods.description: Generates SQL for inverse distribution functions with ordering within groups.

methods.name: visitUserDefinedScalarFunction
methods.description: Throws exception; placeholder for UDF scalar functions.

methods.name: visitUserDefinedAggregateFunction
methods.description: Throws exception; placeholder for UDF aggregate functions.

methods.name: visitUnexpectedExpr
methods.description: Handles unsupported or unexpected expressions, throwing an exception.

methods.name: visitOverlay
methods.description: Generates SQL for OVERLAY string functions.

methods.name: visitTrim
methods.description: Generates SQL for TRIM functions with specified direction.

methods.name: visitGetArrayItem
methods.description: Throws exception; array item access not supported.

methods.name: visitExtract
methods.description: Generates SQL for EXTRACT expressions.

methods.name: visitExtract
methods.description: Generates SQL for EXTRACT with field and source.

methods.name: visitSortOrder
methods.description: Generates SQL for sort order clauses.

methods.name: joinArrayToString
methods.description: Joins array of strings into a single string with delimiters, prefix, and suffix.

methods.name: joinListToString
methods.description: Joins list of strings into a single string with delimiters, prefix, and suffix.

methods.name: expressionsToStringArray
methods.description: Converts array of Expressions to array of SQL strings.

methods.name: expressionsToStringList
methods.description: Converts array of Expressions to list of SQL strings with offset and length.
